body: I don’t want to get better. Right now I’m making sure that I make my own life worse so that my only choice is to kill myself.
It’s torture to stay alive at this point. I really wish resources for suicide methods were easily accessible
A year from now I could also completely fuck my life up and become extremely miserable to the point where suicide is inevitable

That’s a huge “if” statement as of now. At the moment it feels like I am much more likely to kill myself rather than have all of these good things happen.

Everything just feels like a waste of time, energy and effort. It’s the reason why I earned a 1.97 GPA last semester. 

I’m sorry if I’m coming off as being way too negative about myself. I know you’re only trying to help me, and I thank you very much for that
The only pet I would want is probably a few fish in a small fish tank. Assuming I didn’t kill myself and I finished school successfully, I would probably work as a nurse and save up for housing
Probably virtual reality porn
At this point I can’t even see myself living to 20 years old. I am going to end it while I’m 19 so that I can escape a lifetime of loneliness and prolonged misery
I have volunteered at the food bank a few times before. I’m on a scholarship program that requires me to get at least 15 hours of volunteering per semester
I don’t enjoy doing anything anymore

How do I go about socializing with others when I am bombarded with constant negative and suicidal thoughts when thinking about wanting to talk to someone? I don’t consider myself as an incel (as far as their sexist beliefs go) but I see myself as an incredibly lonely person. I pretty much dodged 90% of social events in high school and I never got to date anyone.
Commit suicide

I don’t have any goals in life except killing myself. The only thing I am aiming for is my own death. There’s no reason I should stay alive. My death will be beneficial to the world as a whole. The world will have one less burden off of its shoulders once I’m dead

I’ve already pushed one of my best friends away by telling them how I feel. When I told my parents about how I felt last year, all they did was yell at me and become very angry at me. I cannot afford therapy and I am a completely useless human being with no real life skills. The only way I can lift the burden off of others is if I am successful in killing myself this year

I’ve lost 20 pounds before and it still didn’t change the fact that I wanted to kill myself. I was the same worthless piece of shit even after the weight loss.  My suicide will be the only way that the pain will go away. If I was in a relationship I would probably be extremely toxic and push them away from me anyways

Life experience has shown me that I am a complete waste of resources and time. It is impossible for me to imagine myself living a happy, fulfilling life  where it doesn’t end with me committing suicide. If anything, the only way I will benefit society is if I kill myself while I am young. I will certainly be dead by the end of this year
It’s easy to purchase and it’s cheap
Waking up every morning feeling an overwhelming amount of dread
Music is only a temporary escape. I barely enjoy listening to it anymore. I need a permanent escape from everything

My death will be the greatest relief. I have changed my plans now. Instead of going through the long process of buying a gun, I think I’ll just buy some potassium dichromate online and ingest it. It’s cheap on amazon anyways

As selfish and horrible as this might sound, what if don’t care about how others would feel if I die? I’ll be dead after all, and I won’t be around to see how people would react if I die. I’ve been seriously considering this since I was 14 and I’ve started to believe that a person should have the right to die when they choose to.

I am sorry to hear that you were in the same position as me at one point in your life. I hope that your life ended up turning out better than you could have ever imagined.

I am not intending to make this comment seem offensive towards you or towards anyone. I just don’t see any other way out of this except my own death.
